derivation.permutation: p(j)=2j if j<ceil(N/2), else 2(N-1-j)+1; v_j=x_p(j). This orders even indices upward then odd indices downward.
derivation.forward: theta_k=pi*k/(2N), alpha_0=1/sqrt(N), alpha_k>0=sqrt(2/N). C_k=alpha_k*Re(V_k*exp(-i theta_k)), V=DFT_N(v). Recover k>N/2 from conjugate V_(N-k).
derivation.inverse: U_k=C_k/alpha_k; V_0=U_0. For k>0, V_k=(U_k-i U_(N-k))*exp(+i theta_k); evenN Nyquist imaginary part is0. irfft lengthN returns v; x_q=v_(q/2) for evenq, else v_(N-1-floor(q/2)).
derivation.separable: Forward activeaxesZ,Y,X; inverseX,Y,Z; singletonaxesidentity. Fuse each phase result directly into the next axis even/odd layout. Final inverse restores native logical axes.
derivation.response: At final forward unpack divide by the original restored core.divisors tensor and set DC0; final inverse unpack subtracts first-cell pressure. Generic controls use arbitrary positive nonphysical divisors and independent explicit cosine matrices. No physical eigenvalues/numerical pressure inverse.

precision.phase_constants: GPUfloat64 geometry-only and prewarmed outside capture
